meta.title: ref(relay): Use `to_owned` instead of `to_string`.
meta.body_summary: Replace string literal .to_string() calls with .to_owned() for &str to String conversions across relay codebase, claiming small performance gain; maintainer notes that Cursor only handled trivial cases and regex found more occurrences.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor replaced 105 trivial string literal .to_string() with .to_owned(); maintainer extended with regex to catch 1000+ more, merged quickly with lightweight approval.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2466 changed lines across 95 files, this is a large change by absolute volume, but most of it (2228 lines) came from the maintainer's subsequent regex-based augmentation; the agent's part was modest. The PR fits a bulk refactoring performance tweak that was merged quickly after the maintainer improved coverage.

review_details.performance_claim: Using .to_owned() instead of .to_string() is slightly more efficient for &str to String conversions.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor could only find and replace 105 trivial occurrences of .to_string() on string literals, missing over 1000 others that were correctly caught by a simple regex search-and-replace. This indicates a limited ability to perform exhaustive syntactic transformations across a large codebase compared to dedicated CLI tools.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks, profiling, or before/after measurements; only implicit performance knowledge.

core_change_summary.description: Replace .to_string() calls on string literals with .to_owned() across the relay codebase to avoid unnecessary Display trait method overhead; Cursor's commits replaced ~105 occurrences in several modules, while the maintainer's subsequent commit used a regex to replace over 1000 more occurrences in many additional files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The maintainer's regex-based commit (4888ee) contributed the bulk of the changes (2228 lines) and extended the optimization to many more files missed by Cursor.
change_trajectory: Cursor agent opened PR with three commits replacing trivial .to_string() occurrences in ~40 files.
Maintainer Dav1dde added a formatting fix and then a large commit expanding the replacement to 1000+ more occurrences using a regex.
Approved by Litarnus with a shipit comment, then merged within 38 minutes.

review_signals.summary: Reviewed and approved with shipit emoticon.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by Cursor agent with initial set of replacements.
Maintainer immediately converted to draft and added formatting fix.
Maintainer then added a comprehensive commit expanding the optimization to many more files.
PR merged within 38 minutes of creation.
